title: Overwrite Values
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox/Math Functions/Matrices and Linear Algebra/Matrix Operations/Overwrite_Values.md
text: Overwrite submatrix or subdiagonal of input, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Ending row} sets Ending row; {Overwrite}, {Source of overwriting value(s)} sets the source of overwriting values Specify via, {Overwrite with}, {Row span} sets the span of input rows Range, {Row/Starting row} sets the row or starting, {Row index/Starting row index} sets the row index or starting row index, {Row offset/Starting row offset} sets the row offset or starting row offset, {Ending row index} sets the index of last row of submatrix, {Ending row offset}, {Column span} sets the span of input columns Range, {Column/Starting column} sets the column or starting, {Column index/Starting column index} sets the column index or starting column index, {Column offset/Starting column offset} sets the column offset or starting column offset, {Ending column}, {Ending column index}, {Ending column offset}, {Diagonal span} sets the span of diagonal elements Range, {Element/Starting element} sets the element or starting, {Element index/Starting element index} sets the element or starting element index, {Ending element}, {Ending element index}, {Element offset/Starting element offset} sets the element offset or starting element offset and {Ending element offset}. Values come from the instance.
